title: Talkha Delta Fertilizer workers sit in against land sale/liquidation and worker displacement
location: Delta Fertilizer Company / Talkha plant, Talkha, Dakahlia Governorate
participants_original: Hundreds of workers; later January report says hundreds of workers/families
threshold_50_evidence: Egypt Independent/Al-Masry Al-Youm reports hundreds of workers in the sit-in; Al-Manassa later describes hundreds gathering. This exceeds 50 qualitatively, though onset and later family share differ.

start_date.summary: Egypt Independent dated Dec 5 says sit-in occurred Friday Dec 4; search-only Al-Araby Dec 16 says began Dec 3; Jan 3 Al-Manassa says day 33, implying approx Dec 2.

location.summary: Delta Fertilizer Company/Talkha plant, Talkha in Dakahlia.

demands.summary: Opposition to state-public-enterprise land transfer/liquidation and worker displacement; seek continued operation/development and job security.

participants.summary: December 5 account says hundreds of workers; January continuation says workers/families by the hundreds.

threshold_50.summary: Contemporaneous article describes hundreds of workers in this sit-in.

state_target.summary: Challenge to Dakahlia governor/state public-company land and relocation decision; later workers appeal to President Sisi.

end_date.summary: January 3 report says sit-in was ongoing on its 33rd day, demonstrating cross-boundary continuity; exact endpoint unknown.

protester_violence.summary: One worker explicitly describes the sit-in as peaceful; this is attributed testimony, pending review.

notes: Candidate remains dated Dec 4 per contemporaneous Egypt Independent article’s “Friday” before Dec 5 publication. Later search-result coverage says Dec 3; Jan 3 day-33 follow-up implies about Dec 2. Preserve this onset discrepancy as an open field gap; do not merge multiple reports into independent evidence when shared origin is identified.

title: Kafr El Dawar textile workers sit in against alleged demolition/liquidation and layoffs
location: Misr Spinning and Weaving Company, Kafr El Dawar, Beheira Governorate
participants_original: Some workers estimated more than 4,500 on day two; another passage says around 4,000; Al-Araby reports workers and families in the hundreds
threshold_50_evidence: DARB reports worker estimates above 4,500 and approximately 4,000 at the same day-two sit-in; both exceed 50. Al-Araby corroborates hundreds of workers/families but does not separate family counts.

start_date.summary: DARB reports the sit-in began at 08:00 on Dec 26; Al-Araby says since noon Dec 26.

location.summary: Misr Spinning and Weaving Company in Kafr El Dawar, Beheira Governorate.

demands.summary: Opposition to demolition/land transfer, liquidation and layoffs; seek development, clear assurances and worker job/security guarantees.

participants.summary: DARB gives worker estimates >4,500 and around 4,000; Al-Araby reports workers and families in hundreds.

threshold_50.summary: Either of DARB's worker estimates is far above 50.

state_target.summary: Worker protest concerns a public enterprise/company site transfer under state planning; DARB reports workers sought an answer from Presidency/state officials.

state_response.summary: DARB reports police presence nearby and says workers reported no response from company/officials; no dispersal or arrest is evidenced in these bodies.

end_date.summary: Search-only DARB result says it ended after four days on Dec 29; this result was not opened and is not used as a coded end date.

notes: DARB says action began at 08:00 Dec 26 and continued through day two; Al-Araby confirms start at noon Dec 26 and ongoing Dec 28. A search-only Dec 29 DARB result says it ended after four days, but the body was not opened and no endpoint is assigned.
